scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n backend,frontend,tienda -c blue,green,magenta "npm run backend" "npm run frontend" "npm run tienda"
scripts.setup: npm ci && npm ci --include=dev --prefix backend && npm ci --include=dev --prefix frontend && npm ci --include=dev --prefix tienda
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix tienda
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run lint --prefix tienda
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend && npm test --prefix tienda
